sloka: ददृशुस्तां महाभागां प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम् ।सीतां कृत्स्नास्त्रयो लोकाः पुण्यामाज्याहुतीमिव ।। ६.११९.३१ ।।
transliteration: dadṛśustāṁ mahābhāgāṁ praviśantīṁ hutāśanam ।sītāṁ kṛtsnāstrayo lokāḥ puṇyāmājyāhutīmiva ।। 6.119.31 ।।

translations.english: Like freshly polished gold, like shining gold ornament, in the presence of the whole world she fell into flaming and glowing fire.
